positions.name: MissingIdReproductionRequirements
positions.frame: what must a test sample demonstrate to count as a faithful reproduction of a known production defect?
positions.why: Both expressions describe the same test artifact from two angles: src-1 asserts it reproduces a real production failure pattern (missing id field on a heading), src-2 states the correctness bar the reproduction must clear (no crash, valid slug). Read together they specify what 'faithful reproduction' means operationally — matching the defect's shape while still meeting the system's baseline contract. Register and conviction differ (technical/claim vs. matter-of-fact/decision) but both serve the same specification act, not competing claims.
